content.name: after the fall
content.author: Franko F
content.description:
[b]The war is over. The xenon... won. The galaxy burns, and we cower behind the Bastions. They are citadels that guard the gates, the only thing that preserves our fragile existence.[/b]
Why wait for an endgame crisis if you can *start* the game in crisis?
This mod changes the game start, expands Xenon territory, weakens the allied factions. Only recommended for experienced players who like the more strategic elements of the game.
[hr][/hr] [h1]The Details[/h1]
[h2]After the Fall - An X4 mod of what happens once the Xenon have won.[/h2]
The various factions have been forced back to their home systems, and the xenon have overrun the galaxy. Their economies weakened, the Xenon dominant. The Bastions, powerful defence stations at each gate, are a fragile defence against a hostile galaxy.
Given that this is really aimed at experienced players that want a tougher start, I recommend a custom start.
We also provide 3 (hopefully fun!) custom starts under 'End of Days' section:
[h2]Compatibility[/h2] I've tried to keep the changes as tight in scope as possible to increase compatility with other mods. Most should work fine, but in case you're wondering, check the following section on specific changes. In general though, most changes are applied when galaxy is created. Sectors change hands, # of ships built are altered.
We don't make any core logic changes, mission changes, add new ships, wares, etc.
Some vanilla missions might be very hard to complete though, given galaxy state!
[h1]The Changes:[/h1] [olist] [*] Change existing JOBs. [list] [*] Ally factions do NOT start with L/XL destroyers/carriers. Instead, they will be built in their shipyards till fleets are at full strength. [*] Xenon: All ship numbers have been increased significantly (3x to 5x). It's still a large galaxy, and the Xenon are now spread through it. Xenon economy also has had a massive boost. The assault waves will be relentless. [/list] [*] Moved all stations to the new, smaller territories for the factions as listed below. Xenon defence stations and shipyards have been placed in these locations instead, flipping ownership to xenon. [*] Added some new resource fields to new faction home systems, as many of these systems had few, or no, resources. It's a few small, moderately dense resource fields to keep the factions economies slowly moving, but you'll need to help them get new territory. [*] Weakened faction economies by reducing the number of starting factories. They can expand to build more, but at the start, they're weakend, with a stronger xenon. [*] Added 6 race-specific defence stations around each gate. I tried to position them exactly in a ring around each gate; but the game moves them around on game start. This means that some gates will have a very strong defensive line, others will have big gaps. Oh well. Those factions might struggle a bit more then... [*] Lots of abandoned ships! We've scattered many new abandoned ships of various sizes around the galaxy, mostly in Xenon territory. there are even some battlefields featureing many ships in a single location, from S to XL. Go exploring! These locations are static for each version of the mod; but are randomly generated when I regenerate the mod: so they may not be in the same place from mod version to mod version. [/olist]
All changes are on GAME START only.
[h1]Gamestarts[/h1]
[h2]New starts[/h2] [h3]Me and my Fish Ship[/h3] A former pirate who has lost everything but his loyal crew and a light carrier. It will be a long path back to fielding a fleet again. (harder start)
[h3]Just an Honest Scrap Hauler[/h3] There's a lot of money to be made in a universe filled with scrap from endless war. Start with a large scrap processing station, and a small fleet of scap haulers and traders, but no military ships. Strong starting economy from which to build.
[h3]Battlecarrier Galaxy[/h3] Lead your rag tag band of refuges through a dangerous galaxy, trying to find a new home. Start in the middle of nowhere, surrounded by Xenon sectors. You have a battlecarrier with dozens of fighters, a couple of destroyers and a large number of miners and freighters that you have to somehow protect as you search for Earth (Or Trinity III or Argon Prime. I'm not judging who you want to join).
[h2]Custom start tips[/h2] The galaxy starts off quite a bit rougher, with less safe sectors and weaker faction economies. This means that your own growth may be slower - Without a strong economy, building stations or ships may take a bit longer; and earning money to buy blueprints will be hard. With that in mind, I recommend you give yourself a headstart to avoid an early grind. Exactly how much is up to you. It may be possible to do a zero-to-hero run. The closest I've tested was the 'Me and my guppy' game start. It was challenging. RNG may screw you.
Salvage start, or hull parts/claytronics can help the factions rebuild their broken economies, and provide profitsss! ('Honest Scrap hauler' gamestart)
I recommend setting several story starts to complete, as they will be harder to do now. Boron storyline especially, if you want easy access to them.
For starting locations, the existing unclaimed sectors still exist - you could set yourself up an empire in one of those, OR select one of the safe faction territories given below.
After a tough game? Start in Grand Exchange or elsewhere, then seek out safe space to call home! ('Battlecarrier' gamestart)
[h2]Safe locations[/h2] A good place to start is within faction territory: Each has 3 sectors, spread over one or two clusters. Some factions are back to back with each other. These are slightly safer for an easier start gives more options for missions and trade.
[h3]Neutral sectors:[/h3] I've also cleared any factions & Xenon from some sectors to give players a few options to set up base, and give some factions a little bit of breathing room and protection for their trade from Xenon raids. Be warned - it won't take long for Xenon to expand in to these territories. Start with *strong* defence. This is the masochist choice.
[list] [*] Grand Exchange (all 3 sectors. Good starting location if you set up defences, but there is Xenon territory between you and other factions for trade) [*] Second Contact (right between Arg and Ant. If you claim this, you'll help Ant/Argt trade without being raided by Xenon.) [*] Bright Promise (Between TEL and PAR. Claiming this helps protect PAR/TEL trade and makes these two stronger.) [*] Morningstar IV, Eighteen Billion, Holy Vision, Hewas Twin V [*] Family Zhin, Zyarth's Dominion I, Family Nhuut, Wretched Skies X [*] Oort Cloud [/list] Any other empty territories in vanilla remain.
[h3]Easier Starts[/h3] [list] [*] VIG and RIP factions: With all the xenon raiding parties, a scrap processing setup would do well! Avarice, and windfall sectors: They retain all territory. [*] PIO and ANT. Sharing borders in Segaris, Gaian prophecy, Brennans Triumph, Antigone Memorial, The Void. [*] ARG and HAT in Argon Prime, The Reach, Morningstar III, Hatikvahs choice. [/list]
[h3]Medium[/h3] [*] PAR: Trinity Sanctum III, VII, Hewas Twin (where TEL also have one sector)
[h3]Harder[/h3] [list] [*] TEL: They're slightly isolated in Ianumus Zura. [*] HOP: they've been forced back to a corner, with strong Xenon presense on their border. Cardinals Redress Lasting Vengence. Freedoms Reach [*] ZYA: Far from anyone else, and surrounded by Xenon. Zyarth D IV,X, Eleventh Hour [*] FRF: Also far from help Tharka's Ravine XVI, XXIV, Heart of Acrimony II [*] TER: The homeworld is lost! In Mercury, Venus and Mars. They may have Asgards, but the Xenon flood Sol. [/list]
